options_compared.reason: It proves the pipeline can learn task0 under a higher LR (5/5 fixed init3 and 12/20 paired), but it is not LR-matched to the current 4-task 1e-4 recipe.
The standalone native task0 conversion is now fully audited, but its task-only normalization statistics differ from the pooled four-task stats used by the current joint4 checkpoint.

Use only episodes 0-49 (task0) from the exact frozen 0-3 LeRobot dataset, preserve its global stats, model initialization, optimizer, LR, scheduler, and 40k updates. Batch2 yields the same 80k task0 sample draws as joint4 (2 task0 samples/update x 40k steps), making this the most informative single-task/current-recipe comparison.
The current four-task fixed-init3 gate is 4/5, not 5/5; this would violate the registered progression gate.
